name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the hard goal of reaching the exit, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard keeps the exit from coming before the switch toggle, as the task's 'must have flipped the switch first' requires. The compiler clue that every finishing run includes switch_toggled and at_exit matches the task, and no clause is added or redundant.

texts: Reach the exit (the agent must stand on the exit cell at some point).
The switch must be flipped before the agent reaches the exit; toggling the switch comes first in the order.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
